event_name: Trade News | April 3, 2025 BASF launches aroma ingredients with reduced Product Carbon Footprints to enable customers reach their sustainability targets Ludwigshafen, Germany – BASF Aroma Ingredients has successfully launched L-Menthol FCC rPCF as its first product with a reduced Product Carbon Footprint (rPCF)
